# Founderie Labs

> Founderie Labs LLP is a product studio, software services and IT consulting company registered in India, serving clients worldwide. It builds and launches its own software products (e.g. Kadha), builds websites, custom software and mobile apps on demand, paid in cash, royalty (revenue share) or equity, and provides IT consulting (including fractional CTO), IT training, and dedicated engineers (staff augmentation).

Key facts:
- Legal name: Founderie Labs LLP (Limited Liability Partnership, India). Brand: Founderie Labs.
- Location: India; remote-first; clients in India, USA, UK, EU, UAE, Singapore, Australia.
- Contact: hello@founderielabs.com; WhatsApp/phone +91 99999 99999; https://founderie-labs.vercel.app/contact
- Positioning: product studio + services + consulting. An engineering company that ships its own products and explains technology in plain English for non-technical business owners.
- Products: Kadha, "the journal that turns into your tracker" (AI journaling app that converts spoken/typed/WhatsApp entries into health & wellness trackers; iOS, Android, WhatsApp; closed beta early 2027; https://kadha-flame.vercel.app/). More products planned; the list lives at https://founderie-labs.vercel.app/products
- Guarantees: written fixed-scope quotes, weekly demos, client owns all code/accounts/data, 30-day post-launch defect warranty, no lock-in.
- Payment models: Cash (fixed price or retainer); Royalty (30–60% lower upfront fee plus capped/time-limited % of revenue); Equity/stake (selective, technical co-founder role).
- Indicative pricing (cash): websites US$1.5k–6k; online stores US$4k–15k; internal tools US$6k–30k; mobile apps US$12k–50k; SaaS MVP US$20k–80k; automation/AI US$2k–25k.
- Typical stack: TypeScript/React/Next.js, Flutter/React Native, Node.js/Python/Go, PostgreSQL, AWS/GCP/Azure.
- No public portfolio yet (young company). Team: small core team of partners plus a private network of engineers brought in per project; every project is led by a partner.
